__comment: The Carpenter's own workbench (doc 293): a thick slab hewn flat on top, half of a great log with its round side down, on four peeled log legs braced low with log rails, after the owner's picture of a log workbench. Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the crude workbench from three matching logs; it keeps their wood. The slab's top stands 1.125 blocks high inside the 3 x 1 collision envelope.

Its window's Craft items opens the Carpenter's page (crafting_recipe); the page's other recipes will be made here, their goods lying on the slab where it is nearest the Carpenter, crafting_surface_inset inside its edges.
description: A thick slab hewn flat on top, on four peeled log legs braced low with log rails: the Carpenter's own workbench. Occupies a 3 by 1 space and is worked from either long side.
